quarter.zh: 2027 财年第二季（9 月季度）

en: Record second-quarter revenue of $1,443M (+27%) came from licensing, up 50% to $773M, while royalties rose only 8% to $670M, about $50M below estimates as costly memory hit smartphone volumes. Data-center royalties again more than doubled. Non-GAAP EPS was $0.52 against $0.48 expected. Management is now more confident of up to $2B of AGI CPU revenue across FY27–FY28, with first deliveries on track for the March quarter. Related parties, mainly SoftBank, were about 29% of revenue.

The stock closed at $191.80 on Nov 4, about 15% below its pre-Q1 level and more than half below its June high, then slipped roughly 2–4% after hours. The Q3 guide of $1.54B ±$50M and EPS of $0.56 was only in line with consensus, non-GAAP opex steps up to about $825M, and the royalty miss revived the phone-demand worry. The first regular-session reaction comes on Nov 5.
zh: 第二季营收创同期纪录，达 14.43 亿美元（+27%），主要来自授权收入增长 50% 至 7.73 亿美元；版税收入仅增 8% 至 6.7 亿美元，比预期低约 5000 万美元，原因是内存涨价拖累智能手机出货。数据中心版税再次翻倍以上。经调整每股收益 0.52 美元，高于预期的 0.48 美元。管理层对 FY27–FY28 实现最高 20 亿美元 AGI CPU 收入更有信心，首批交付预计在 3 月季度。关联方（主要是软银）约占营收 29%。
股价 11 月 4 日收于 191.80 美元，较第一季财报前低约 15%，较 6 月高点下跌逾一半，盘后又下跌约 2–4%。第三季指引营收 15.4 亿美元 ±5000 万、每股收益 0.56 美元，仅与市场预期持平；非 GAAP 运营费用升至约 8.25 亿美元；版税不及预期再度引发对手机需求的担忧。常规交易时段的首个反应将在 11 月 5 日出现。

bio.en: Joined Arm in 2013 after seven years at NVIDIA running its computing products business, and led Arm's IP products group before becoming CEO in 2022. Took Arm public in 2023 and is moving it from licensing designs toward selling its own chips.
bio.zh: 在英伟达负责计算产品业务七年后，于 2013 年加入 Arm，曾掌管 IP 产品部门，2022 年出任 CEO。2023 年带领 Arm 上市，正推动公司从授权设计转向销售自研芯片。

bio.en: Joined Arm in 2022 ahead of its 2023 IPO. Previously CFO of Splunk from 2019 and of Groupon, which he took public in 2011, and earlier CFO of Amazon International.
bio.zh: 2022 年加入 Arm，为 2023 年上市做准备。此前 2019 年起任 Splunk CFO，也曾任 Groupon CFO 并于 2011 年带领其上市，更早时担任亚马逊国际业务 CFO。
